tasks.title: Founding scaffold — contract, roadmap, harness, baton, golden component
tasks.doneWhen: The contract is frozen and twice-verified, the hook floor is test-fired both ways, the baton board resolves dependencies, and the golden component's tests pass against a mocked store.

tasks.title: Scaffold the client app shell (Vite, React, Tailwind, Redux Toolkit, react-router) with /generate and /preview/:pageName routes
tasks.doneWhen: npm run dev serves both routes; the Redux store is attached at the app root and the cms slice namespace exists even if empty.

tasks.title: Scaffold the Express API skeleton with route stubs for every endpoint in §13
tasks.doneWhen: Every path in the §13 table responds (even as a stub) and GET /api/health returns the §13.4 shape. §13.4's envelope convention is enforced centrally — acting endpoints return { ok, ... }, collection reads a bare array, single-document reads a bare doc or 404, and errors the { ok: false, error } envelope whatever the endpoint. The route table and its handlers import nothing, so the verification runs on a fresh clone with no npm install.

tasks.title: Define the store adapter interface (§2.1) and a store factory selecting Mongo or the JSON store from environment
tasks.doneWhen: The factory exports exactly the seven functions named in §2.1, with no _id or $oid ever crossing the interface.

tasks.title: Implement the JSON file store with an atomic allocateId (single-writer queue, not read-modify-write)
tasks.doneWhen: 50 concurrent allocateId('element') calls return 50 unique, strictly increasing, 10-digit string IDs.

tasks.title: Implement the Mongo store with an atomic allocateId via findOneAndUpdate
tasks.doneWhen: allocateId is atomic under concurrent calls against a real or in-memory Mongo instance; _id and $oid never appear in a returned document.

tasks.title: Implement the ID allocator's three sanctioned ranges (§1) on top of the store adapter
tasks.doneWhen: allocateId('section'|'element'|'cardField') returns a 10-digit string starting 1/2/3 respectively; Math.random, Date.now, uuid and nanoid appear nowhere in the file.

tasks.title: Write the Section and Element document models matching §2 and §3 exactly, tolerant of the source appendix's extra ignored fields
tasks.doneWhen: A document carrying _id, pageId, layoutPlacementId and the other appendix-only fields loads without error and round-trips the required fields unchanged.

tasks.title: Write the cms Redux slice matching §5.2's slice state exactly
tasks.doneWhen: state.cms has exactly allSections, allSectionsCss, sectionNames, status, error, missing, with the initial values §5.2 implies.
